stories.headline: Xi defends open trade at APEC
stories.dek: His Shenzhen speech backs the WTO and a 21-economy free-trade area; Putin is in the city.
stories.art: Flat podium, China flag, open gate and a ring of 21 small trade arrows

stories.headline: Kuwait says it is repelling drones
stories.dek: Kuwait says it countered hostile drones on Wednesday, hours after US strikes on Qeshm Island.
stories.art: Flat Kuwait coast, two intercepted drones and a radar dish

stories.headline: Nvidia board rejects Huang return
stories.dek: Directors back interim CEO Colette Kress after quarterly revenue of $116 billion.
stories.art: Flat green chip with a crossed return arrow and a bar marked 116

stories.headline: Xi and Lee talk Korea and chips
stories.dek: Lee Jae Myung asked Xi to help peninsula peace; Xi offered work on supply chains.
stories.art: Two flat flags, a peninsula outline and a linked chip chain

stories.headline: White House drops FDA nominee
stories.dek: The White House withdrew Heidi Overton's nomination to lead the FDA before a Senate vote.
stories.art: Flat White House and a nameplate slid into a tray

stories.headline: Peltola takes Alaska Senate seat
stories.dek: Mary Peltola defeated Republican Dan Sullivan; Democrats now hold a 56-44 Senate majority.
stories.art: Alaska outline, a ballot and the figures 56 and 44

stories.headline: US loses measles-free status
stories.dek: PAHO says endemic measles has returned in the US, Mexico and Bolivia; the CDC urges shots.
stories.art: Flat syringe beside a measles spot and three country outlines

stories.headline: Australia presses 2030 net zero
stories.dek: At COP31 in Antalya, Canberra's draft asks rich countries for net zero by 2030.
stories.art: Flat sun over a draft paper marked 2030 and a small Australia map

stories.headline: Trump says tech outages are fine
stories.dek: Trump says the outage wave is fine; the NSA cites a short loss of service during maintenance.
stories.art: Flat server rack with one amber light and a check mark

stories.headline: UK sanctions settler-linked firms
stories.dek: Britain sanctioned Israeli firms linked to settlements; Europe condemned over 1,200 homes.
stories.art: Flat gavel, a UK flag and a row of small house icons

stories.headline: Merchant gets a 330-month term
stories.dek: The Justice Department says Asif Merchant received 330 months over a plot to kill Trump.
stories.art: Flat courtroom bench and a calendar block reading 330

stories.headline: Pakistan, Turkmenistan revive TAPI
stories.dek: Ishaq Dar and Rashid Meredov signed a cooperation protocol and a tourism pact.
stories.art: Flat pipeline across a simple map from Turkmenistan toward Pakistan

stories.headline: SHENZHEN: Anwar criticises one-way trade talk
stories.dek: Anwar Ibrahim told APEC bosses open-trade talk cannot apply to one country only.
stories.art: Flat microphone and two arrows, one of them blocked

stories.headline: MANILA: Rubio says Trump is serious about Kim
stories.dek: Marco Rubio said Trump is prepared to meet Kim Jong Un, though a meeting may not happen.
stories.art: Flat two chairs and a question mark between two flags

stories.headline: TAIPEI: Envoy Shih says Taiwan goes with a smile
stories.dek: Acer founder Stan Shih, sent as Chinese Taipei, said Taiwan would go with a smile.
stories.art: Flat island, a small smile badge and a name card

stories.headline: MANILA: Trump to see Marcos, then fly to China
stories.dek: A Wednesday meeting with Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is due before Trump flies on to Shenzhen.
stories.art: Flat plane hopping from Manila toward a south China coast

stories.headline: ANTALYA: 33 faith groups pledge fossil divestment
stories.dek: The World Council of Churches named 33 institutions; campaigners put wider pledges over $40tn.
stories.art: Flat chapel and a coal lump crossed out, numeral 33

stories.headline: LONDON: Red Wednesday lights mark the persecuted
stories.dek: Aid to the Church in Need says 964,003 pounds of a 1 million pound goal is already in.
stories.art: Flat cathedral washed in red light and a coin jar

stories.headline: TRURO: Ex-Methodist leader guilty on 11 counts
stories.dek: A jury in Truro convicted the Rev Steven Wild, 72, of 11 offences against five women.
stories.art: Flat jury box and the number 11 on a verdict card

stories.headline: LONDON: UK pay settlements rise to 3.2 percent
stories.dek: Brightmine says UK pay settlements in the three months to October edged up to 3.2 percent.
stories.art: Flat pay slip with 3.2 percent and a small rising line

stories.headline: OSLO: Haaland penalty sends Norway through
stories.dek: Erling Haaland's injury-time penalty put Norway above Denmark and into the quarter-finals.
stories.art: Flat goalmouth and a ball on a penalty spot

stories.headline: LISBON: Portugal wins first game of new era
stories.dek: Dawn reported Portugal's first win of the post-Ronaldo era on the same match night.
stories.art: Flat scoreboard and a Portugal shield

stories.headline: TURIN: Zverev reaches the ATP Finals last four
stories.dek: Alexander Zverev won in straight sets; Rafael Jodar, beaten earlier by Arthur Fils, went out.
stories.art: Flat tennis court with a straight-sets scoreboard

stories.headline: NASSAU: Woods, 50, set to return next month
stories.dek: Officials say Tiger Woods, 50, will play next month's Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas.
stories.art: Flat golf green, a ball and the number 50

stories.headline: CALIFORNIA: Waymo suspends freeway robotaxis
stories.dek: Waymo paused freeway trips after California banned its robotaxis from state freeways.
stories.art: Flat robotaxi stopped at a freeway sign

stories.headline: SEOUL: Exam rules sticker every clothing button
stories.dek: Stickers will cover every button at Thursday's exam; Lee Jae Myung vowed zero tolerance.
stories.art: Flat exam shirt with a sticker on each button

stories.headline: SANGJU: Magnitude 3.6 quake shakes south Korea
stories.dek: SBS said the 3.6 shock was South Korea's largest inland quake in 2 years and 5 months.
stories.art: Flat seismograph spike marked 3.6 over a town

stories.headline: KARACHI: Bilawal says Sindh split risks bloodshed
stories.dek: Bilawal Bhutto Zardari said forcing a new province out of Sindh could mean bloodshed.
stories.art: Flat province outline with a warning stripe

stories.headline: ISLAMABAD: ADB lends $500m for pension reform
stories.dek: The bank approved 500 million dollars; Dawn says pension spending now tops 1 trillion rupees.
stories.art: Flat banknote stack marked 500m beside a pension card

stories.headline: ISLAMABAD: Bar members back Imran hospital plea
stories.dek: Eight Pakistan Bar Council members urged compliance with a court order on Imran Khan's care.
stories.art: Flat hospital cross and eight small figures

stories.headline: PESHAWAR: Three PTI leaders held despite bail
stories.dek: Jhagra, Bangash and Irfan Saleem were held under public-order law despite high-court bail.
stories.art: Flat courthouse door and three name plates

stories.headline: RAWALPINDI: Munir discusses ties with UK, Turkiye
stories.dek: Field Marshal Asim Munir discussed defence cooperation with Britain and with Turkiye.
stories.art: Flat three flags linked by a short defence arc

stories.headline: ILOCOS: Raid on a fake FBI hub nets 3 Malaysians
stories.dek: Agents raided a scam office in Ilocos that posed as the FBI and arrested three Malaysians.
stories.art: Flat office sign reading FBI with a slash and three figures

stories.headline: MANILA: Protest greets Trump over Pax Silica
stories.dek: The Inquirer reported a Manila rally against the Pax Silica plan as President Trump visited.
stories.art: Flat crowd and a placard reading Pax Silica

stories.headline: ACCRA: Ghana fans clash with police after Libya loss
stories.dek: GhanaWeb reported fans fought police and match officials after Ghana's defeat by Libya.
stories.art: Flat stadium gate with a scuffle of simple figures

stories.headline: DURHAM: Stojakovic scores 46 on Duke's home floor
stories.dek: Andrej Stojakovic scored 46 points for Illinois, a visiting record on Duke's home floor.
stories.art: Flat basketball and a scoreboard reading 46

stories.headline: GULF: Formula 1 keeps two season finales on
stories.dek: Organisers are keeping two season-ending Middle East races on the calendar despite the war.
stories.art: Flat F1 car on a desert circuit with a checkered flag

stories.headline: FRANKFURT: Leak probe traces Deutsche Bank clients
stories.dek: Dawn says the leak probe covers dealings with Trump, Epstein and Russian oligarchs.
stories.art: Flat bank tower and a folder stamped leak

stories.headline: ROME: Pope Leo says his tumour is contained
stories.dek: Flying home from South America, Pope Leo XIV said the tumour was contained.
stories.art: Flat papal plane and a small medical cross

stories.headline: BOSTON: Harvard links phone bans to small gains
stories.dek: A Harvard-led study found modest learning gains where schools banned pupils' mobile phones.
stories.art: Flat school desk with a phone in a locked box
